Problem Statement:
Given 2 numbers N,K and N arrays each of size K, print the elements that have appeared in all arrays,if any element are not same print '-1'. 
Input Description:
The input consists of 2 numbers N, K, and N arrays each of size K.
Constraints: 2 <= N, K <= 100000 
Output Description:
Print the elements that have appeared in all arrays. If no common elements are found, print '-1'. 
Sample Input:
2 3
1 0 2
0 8 7 
Sample Output:
0
